title: Brückner Group SE - Extrusion-World
content: # Brückner Group SE. The Brückner Group has been family-owned since it was founded in 1960. This has characterised the Group to this day and is reflected in particular in its long-term strategic orientation - a key success factor for our customers and ourselves. Brückner Maschinenbau is the world's leading supplier of production systems for the manufacture of high-quality monoaxially and biaxially stretched films. It was founded in 1960. The systems guarantee customers efficient, profitable and reliable production of a wide variety of flexible films, which are used as high-quality packaging material or for special technical applications, such as capacitors, battery separators or screens and displays. Brückner Maschinenbau's range of services includes the planning, construction and commissioning of complete production plants and turnkey factories as well as all process and machine engineering developments for film production. The globally unique technology centre in Siegsdorf is increasingly working on important future topics such as e-mobility, intelligent packaging and sustainability in film production.

content: The Battery Show North America 2025German Exhibitors Brueckner Maschinenbau GmbH. # Brueckner Maschinenbau GmbH. www.brueckner-maschinenbau.com/en. Brückner Maschinenbau is part of the family-owned Brückner Group, Germany, and is the world's leading supplier of lines for the production of oriented plastic films. Brückner’s lines guarantee international film manufacturers efficient, flexible and profitable film production of all types. * Battery separator film line concepts guaranteeing high energy efficiency, low production costs and consistent film quality. * Sequential as well as simultaneous stretching lines to manufacture extremely thin and high-temperature capacitor films for EV and renewable energy applications in the power industry. The company's range of services includes planning, construction and commissioning of complete production lines and plants as well as all process and mechanical engineering developments for film production. title: The Brückner Group – a global technology company - K Trade Fair
content: ##### Brückner Group GmbH. # The Brückner Group – a global technology company. The Brückner Group has been a family-owned company since it was established in 1960. It stands for technological expertise and the highest quality in the field of machinery and installations for the production and processing of plastics and other packaging materials. * Brückner Group: Strategic management holding and management company for all business areas of the Brückner Group. * Brückner Maschinenbau: World market leader in production installations for the manufacture of films for high-quality packaging material and technical applications. * Kiefel: The leader in serial and special machinery for the processing of plastics in the automobile, refrigeration, medical technology and packaging industries. * PackSys Global: Global player for special machines for the packaging industry. The companies within the group operate independently but share a focus on engineering as their core added value as well as their striving for leadership in technology and on the world market in their individual segments.
